en.title: D23 2026: Kingdom Hearts Panel Hints at Major News for Eager Fans
en.summary: Disney has officially confirmed a dedicated 'Deep Dive into Kingdom Hearts' panel at D23 2026, sparking intense speculation among fans. With key figures from both Disney and Square Enix set to appear, the event is widely anticipated to reveal significant updates on the highly awaited sequel, Kingdom Hearts 4.
en.body:
The 25th anniversary of the beloved **Kingdom Hearts** franchise is set to be a major focal point at the upcoming D23 2026 convention. Disney has officially announced a special panel titled 'Deep Dive into Kingdom Hearts,' a move that has sent ripples of excitement through the global fanbase. While details remain under wraps, the very nature of a dedicated panel, celebrating a quarter-century of the iconic series that masterfully blends Disney magic with Square Enix's RPG prowess, points towards substantial announcements. This isn't just a casual retrospective; it's an event designed to engage the passionate community that has followed Sora's journey across countless worlds.

The guest list for this 'Deep Dive' is particularly telling. Confirmed attendees include **Nana Gadd** from Disney & Pixar Games, **Tai Yasue** from Square Enix (reportedly a co-director on **Kingdom Hearts 4**), and prominent voice actors **Haley Joel Osment** (Sora) and **David Gallagher** (Riku), alongside **Renée Johnson**, known for her work on Disney character voices. The presence of such key figures, especially **Yasue** and the main voice cast, strongly indicates that the panel will go beyond a simple anniversary celebration. Fans are understandably buzzing with the expectation that this is where we will finally receive concrete news, and perhaps even gameplay reveals, for the long-anticipated **Kingdom Hearts 4**.

## A Celebration of 25 Years and a Look Ahead

This dedicated panel is more than just a nod to the series' past; it’s positioned as a significant moment for its future. The official description promises a "behind-the-scenes look at the making of the games," highlighting how the franchise has united beloved Disney and Pixar properties with Square Enix's signature storytelling and gameplay. Given that **Kingdom Hearts 4** was first teased in June 2026 with a striking trailer showcasing Sora in the unfamiliar, realistic setting of Quadratum, the timing for this D23 panel feels *perfect* for a more in-depth reveal. The anticipation for this sequel is immense, especially after its initial surprise appearance during a Nintendo Direct presentation.

## What This Means for the Heart of the Community

For the dedicated **Kingdom Hearts** fanbase, this panel is the culmination of years of hopeful speculation. The community has been analyzing every cryptic clue and eagerly awaiting any official word on **Kingdom Hearts 4**. The fact that **Tai Yasue**, a central figure in the series' development, will be present, alongside the iconic voices of Sora and Riku, elevates this event from a mere convention panel to a potential watershed moment. It signifies a renewed commitment from Square Enix and Disney to engage with fans directly, offering insights and updates that will undoubtedly fuel discussions and theories across every platform until the game's eventual release.

## What's Next

The 'Deep Dive into Kingdom Hearts' panel is scheduled to take place on August 15th at 4:30 PM PT / 7:30 PM ET (August 16th at 12:30 AM UK time) and will be livestreamed. Fans should tune in for what promises to be a pivotal moment for the **Kingdom Hearts** saga.

content_raw: Kingdom Hearts 4 news looks set for later this week after Disney confirmed the details of its Kingdom Hearts panel at fan convention D23. A livestream of the ‘DEEP DIVE into KINGDOM HEARTS panel at D23’ will be available on August 15 at 4.30pm PT / 7.30pm ET / August 16 at 12.30am UK time. Disney said it will offer a “behind-the-scenes look at the making of the games,” but it’s who’s on the panel that has fans excited for what is now expected news on Kingdom Hearts 4. The panel guests are Nana Gadd from Disney & Pixar Games, Tai Yasue from Square Enix, Haley Joel Osment, who voices Sora, David Gallagher, who voices Riku, and Renée Johnson, who is behind the Disney character voices. With a panel like that (Yasue is believed to be co-director of Kingdom Hearts 4), you’d like to think we’ll get something on the hotly anticipated sequel. Kingdom Hearts 4 made a surprise appearance at the June 2026 Nintendo Direct to reveal a first look at gameplay years after the game itself was announced. Just as the presentation was starting to wind down, Sora showed up to tell us what it will be like to wield the Keyblade once more. In a separate post, Square Enix confirmed that Kingdom Hearts 4 will launch simultaneously for PC via Epic Games Store and Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S, as well as Nintendo Switch 2. "A new installment in the action role-playing series developed and published by Square Enix, Kingdom Hearts 4 gives fans a look at some of the characters that protagonist Sora will meet in the mysterious city of Quadratum," an official description for the game said. "Sora will once again journey to realms, where new figures cross his path and new powers awaken his next chapter. Kingdom Hearts 4 will be available at launch on Nintendo Switch 2." Square Enix first revealed Kingdom Hearts 4 at the franchise's 20th anniversary event all the way back in 2022. At the time, an on-rails gameplay segment showed Sora battling a skyscraper-sized Heartless in a city that shared little in common with most of the dreamlike world Disney is known for. There had been next to no announcements since . There is still no release date or even window. Will we get both at D23? Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100.
